question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets|pct}: cash ran ahead of income. Against the company's own history that sits inside the range: the ratio was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2023, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2022 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2021. Fiscal 2025 was the weakest year since fiscal 2022: annual accruals over assets of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} were the second highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} in fiscal 2024, as the cash-flow statement recorded an inventory build of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_fiscal_year}. The trailing window has recovered: trailing operating cash flow changed by {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct} while trailing net income changed by {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, and first-quarter accruals over assets of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} were below the {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} of a year earlier. The first half of fiscal 2026 has the usual seasonal shape: operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} against net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income.parts.this_year_to_date}, up from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income.parts.prior_year_to_date} a year earlier. The quarter alone produced {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}, even though the numbers reader records heavier first-half cash tax payments. Working capital, year over year on the balance sheet: receivables changed by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income), inventory by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}) and payables by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}). Together, trade working capital absorbed {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}. Articulation: the cash-flow statement's trailing inventory line is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}, a release, while the balance sheet shows a rise, leaving a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. Two disclosed facts could produce a gap in this direction. The year-ago inventory balance comes from a 10-Q filed before the change from LIFO to FIFO made late in fiscal 2025, and the Duro Dyne and Supco acquisitions ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} of cash) brought inventory onto the balance sheet outside operating cash flow. Neither is quantified, so the gap stays unresolved. The payables gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap}, which is small and consistent with acquired payables. The receivables articulation cannot be computed: the calculator's cash-flow receivables field is missing because the company tags that line under a combined accounts-and-notes concept the record does not read. Over the trailing year the cash-flow lines show the inventory release roughly offset by falling payables ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_payables}), while receivables built. Working capital therefore did not flatter trailing operating cash flow, and no working-capital adjustment is written. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, below one: quarterly income moves far less than quarterly operating cash flow. For a seasonal heating and cooling business that builds inventory and receivables in the first half, that is the expected shape. The calculator holds no earlier smoothness reading to compare it with.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Earnings are backed by cash over the trailing year and sit inside the company's own history. The fiscal 2025 dip in conversion has reversed. The inventory articulation gap has plausible causes that are not quantified. Income is much smoother than cash, for seasonal reasons.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables grew faster than revenue against the year-ago quarter. The June balance is {terms.balances_now.receivables} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.receivables} a year earlier, while second-quarter revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and trailing revenue changed by {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Quarter-end days sales outstanding are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the second highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the same quarter a year earlier. Receivables over quarterly revenue are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue|pct} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.receivables_over_revenue|pct}. The rise is modest. The first quarter of fiscal 2025 sat higher at {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, and the fiscal 2025 year-end reading of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} was the lowest of the filled years. Receivables brought in by the acquisitions made late in fiscal 2025 are a benign reading that the inputs cannot size. The trailing-average figure of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding} days sets the average of two June balances against trailing revenue, so it is not comparable with the year-end series. Contract liabilities moved against revenue, but they are tiny. Current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, or {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} of quarterly revenue against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}. The notes show more revenue drawn from opening contract liabilities this quarter than in the year-ago quarter. The notes reader found no substantive change in revenue policy wording and no new judgment area; the allocation of service revenue on relative fair value is unchanged. Neither reader found extended-payment-term or bill-and-hold language. Within Home Comfort Solutions, the direct share of revenue slipped slightly against the year-ago quarter and the independent-distributor share rose. Fourth-quarter revenue concentration cannot be tested, because the trend table has no fourth-quarter cell.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Largely clean. Quarter-end receivables days rose modestly against the year-ago quarter, and no disclosed change in terms is tied to the rise.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for doubtful accounts is thinning. It is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} at the end of June against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier, while receivables rose. The reserve ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} is the lowest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier. Fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} was the lowest of the filled years, after {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} in fiscal 2024. The first-half provision was higher than a year earlier, so the falling balance means write-offs ran ahead of provisions. No text explains why a smaller reserve suffices against larger receivables. The income effect is not a calculator field, so no adjustment is written. Warranty reserves move the conservative way. The accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}, and fiscal 2025's warranty ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} was the highest of the filled years. The quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} is above the year-ago quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}, and the first-half change in estimate for pre-existing warranties added to the liability, which lowers income. The inventory reserve is not tagged and cannot be tested; see the industry lens. Tariff refunds: product cost is stated net of IEEPA refunds. Neither reader found text saying whether the refunds are recognised on receipt or accrued as a receivable, which earlier periods they relate to, or whether more are expected. That recognition judgment is not visible in the inputs. Goodwill: a measurement-period adjustment raised Duro Dyne and Supco goodwill and cut net tangible assets acquired, and no text explains it. No headroom, discount-rate or growth assumption is in the inputs, and the notes report no impairment. Tax: the quarter's effective rate rose against the year-ago quarter, and the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. No valuation-allowance release or discrete benefit lifts income, though the tax note warns that an IRS audit including cross-border transactions could settle above reserves. Litigation: the antitrust class actions were amended and consolidated, the company still cannot estimate a loss, and no accrual is visible. Hedges: derivative gains held in accumulated other comprehensive loss are expected to reduce cost of goods sold over the next twelve months.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Mixed. Warranty and tax estimates lean conservative. The doubtful-accounts allowance is the thinnest in the available history, and the recognition basis for the tariff refunds is undisclosed.

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalisation signal can be tested. The record tags no capitalised software or development cost, and no research and development expense for this year to date, so there is no capitalised-versus-expensed comparison. Soft assets are at their highest share: {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of assets this quarter, the highest of the filled quarters, and {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} at fiscal 2025 year-end against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year before. The step-up coincides with the acquisitions made late in fiscal 2025 ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions} of cash) and with higher receivables and inventory. The inputs support that benign reading but cannot split the causes. Capital spending ran at {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization} times depreciation over the trailing year. First-half spending was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}, which MD&A ties to land and buildings for innovation centres. That is investment, not deferred operating cost. The quarter's most material earnings-quality item is a non-recurring credit inside a recurring cost line. Product cost is stated net of tariff refunds that the release calls earlier than expected, and the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier. With that refund included, operating income grew {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct} and net income changed by {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} against the year-ago quarter. Underlying earnings were therefore weaker than reported, and the quarter's margin is not a run-rate. The refund amount appears only in quoted text, not in any calculator field, so no earnings adjustment could be written. 'Losses (gains) and other expenses, net' swung from a gain to a small loss and includes special litigation charges. The non-GAAP gap cannot be measured: the record holds no non-GAAP net income, although the release reports an adjusted EPS figure.
cost_deferral.verdict: No cost capitalisation is visible, but the data needed to test it are absent. The quarter's gross margin is flattered by a one-time tariff refund netted into product cost.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Nothing found on receivables factoring, supplier or supply-chain finance, unconditional purchase obligations or guarantees. The calculator's field for each is missing because the record tags none of them, and neither reader carried a paragraph describing such a programme. That is an absence of evidence in these inputs, not proof that no programme exists. No shift between operating and investing classification is visible: capital spending sits in investing, and MD&A explains its rise. The first-half receivables build was funded with short-term borrowing. Commercial paper outstanding is {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value} a year earlier, total debt is {terms.debt_now} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier}, and debt over debt plus equity is {ratios.solvency.debt_over_debt_plus_equity|pct}. The calculator's short-term borrowing family shows {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_short_term_net}, because the company tags commercial paper issuance and repayment under concepts that family does not read. Its free cash flow to equity therefore leaves that borrowing out; this affects financing, not operating cash. Operating lease liabilities rose to {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}, and the inputs do not explain the rise. A small standby letter-of-credit commitment now appears where the prior quarter's text recorded none. Share-based compensation is {earnings_versus_cash.share_based_compensation_over_revenue|pct} of revenue. It and acquisitions are already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}, against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. If the tariff refunds were accrued rather than received, earnings ran ahead of cash in the quarter; the inputs do not say which.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Clean as far as the inputs reach. Data on factoring, supplier finance, purchase obligations and guarantees are absent. Commercial paper, not operating engineering, funds the receivables build.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The controls item concludes that disclosure controls were effective and reports no change in internal control over financial reporting. The inputs show no material weakness, auditor change, late-filing notice or amendment, and the superseded-value markers the numbers reader traced show unchanged values. The main filing signal is the voluntary change from LIFO to FIFO in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025. The release states that the fiscal 2025 comparatives are adjusted, so prior periods were recast openly rather than quietly. The history the trend table uses, however, mixes bases: older inventory, cost and margin inputs come from filings made before the change. That colours the inventory-days, gross-margin and inventory-articulation readings. With input costs rising on inflation and tariffs, a FIFO basis generally reports lower cost of goods sold than LIFO would, so the change lifts reported margins relative to the old method; the inputs do not quantify the effect. Fiscal 2025's gross margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the filled years, should be read with that in mind. An 8-K filed during the quarter carries the items for officer or director changes and shareholder votes, but its body is not in the inputs. A finance-officer departure can therefore be neither confirmed nor ruled out; no report item or calculator field covers it, so it is recorded here rather than in the anomaly register. The MD&A cross-references a note on the Heat Controller acquisition, completed after the quarter, that is absent from the notes input. A 10-Q carries no critical audit matters, and subsidiary-list changes, comment letters and related-party data are not in the inputs.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: Clean on controls. The change in inventory method recasts history openly but breaks the comparability of the trend table, and one officer-related 8-K body is unseen.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The 8-K release and the 10-Q agree on every number both print: the receivables and inventory cash-flow lines, Home Comfort Solutions segment revenue, the quarter's operating cash flow ({ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}), revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}, and the losses-and-other line, with its sign convention flipped. No numeric contradiction was found. The documents differ in wording, and each difference leans the release's way. The release alone calls the tariff refunds earlier than expected. It attributes revenue growth to acquisitions without the organic volume decline the MD&A bridge shows. It explains the quarter's cash flow by reduced inventory, which the numbers confirm, but neither document mentions that the first-half receivables build was larger than a year earlier. It names Comfort-Aire and Century brands where the 10-Q names Heat Controller. Its headline calls a lower EPS range an update, while free cash flow guidance stays unchanged. Every notes item is reconciled below, and the numbers contradict none of them. Items that make forward claims, or that rest on segment profit, SG&A, equity-method or hedge figures the numbers do not carry, are unresolved.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The release and the 10-Q agree on every shared number. The release's wording is more favourable than the 10-Q's on refund timing, growth attribution, cash-flow drivers and guidance.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: inventory days are high against the company's own history. Fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} was the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in fiscal 2024; the older years sit on the LIFO basis. The first quarter of fiscal 2026 reached {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled quarters, and the second quarter eased to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier. The trailing average is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}. Inventory stands at {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, while Home Comfort Solutions volume fell and management cites factory under-absorption, which is consistent with production being cut to work stock down. No inventory reserve or write-down is tagged, so obsolescence cannot be tested; it is the open risk. Purchase commitments in excess of need: nothing found. The obligation field is not tagged, and no text discusses commitments. Customer concentration: nothing found. The only concentration facts are product facts, with equipment at {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} of revenue in fiscal 2023, {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2025, and no fact names a customer. Channel stuffing: the signals are weak. The distributor share edged up, quarter-end receivables days rose against the year-ago quarter and the allowance thinned. However, the release reports demand improving in both channels, and no extended-terms language appears, so channel stuffing is not established. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found. Equity-method income is called de minimis, and no investment in a customer appears.
industry_lens.verdict: Inventory is the industry risk to watch: inventory days are high while residential volume falls, and there are no reserve data to test it. There is no evidence of customer concentration, excess purchase commitments or vendor financing.

anomalies.what: Fiscal 2025 operating cash flow was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income, the weakest since fiscal 2022, when it was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. Annual accruals over assets of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets|pct} were the second highest of the filled years. The trailing window is back to {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, which MD&A attributes to favourable working capital, and the numbers bear that out.

anomalies.name: Quarterly income is much smoother than quarterly cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 순이익이 영업현금흐름보다 훨씬 평탄함
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarterly net income moves much less than quarterly operating cash flow. The benign reading is the seasonal build of inventory and receivables in the first half. There is no earlier reading to compare against, and no prose addresses it.

anomalies.name: First-half cash taxes rose sharply
anomalies.name_ko: 상반기 법인세 현금납부 급증
anomalies.what: Cash taxes paid in the first half of fiscal 2026 were well above the same half of fiscal 2025, and the change in taxes payable reversed sign; the amounts are in the numbers reader's item. Operating cash flow nonetheless rose to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date}, which supports the quality of the improvement. No text explains the swing.

anomalies.name: Receivables rising faster than revenue against the year-ago quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권이 전년 동기 대비 매출보다 빠르게 증가
anomalies.what: Receivables are {terms.balances_now.receivables} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.receivables} a year earlier, while second-quarter revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and trailing revenue changed by {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Quarter-end days sales outstanding are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. The first-half receivables build on the cash-flow statement was also larger than a year earlier. Acquired receivables are the benign reading, and no text addresses it.

anomalies.name: Fiscal 2025 year-end receivables days at a low
anomalies.name_ko: 2025 회계연도 말 매출채권회전일수 최저
anomalies.what: Fiscal 2025 year-end days sales outstanding of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} were the lowest of the filled years, a favourable departure from the company's past. No text explains it, and the inventory method change does not touch receivables or revenue.

anomalies.name: Contract liabilities falling while revenue rises
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 증가 중 계약부채 감소
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities are {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, while revenue rose. They stand at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct} of quarterly revenue, after the first quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue|pct}, the highest of the filled quarters. The notes show more revenue drawn from opening contract liabilities this quarter, which explains the drawdown. The amounts are immaterial against revenue.

anomalies.name: Independent-distributor share of Home Comfort Solutions revenue edging up
anomalies.name_ko: 가정용 부문 매출 중 독립 유통업체 비중 소폭 상승
anomalies.what: In Home Comfort Solutions, the direct share of revenue slipped slightly against the year-ago quarter and the independent-distributor share rose, while quarter-end receivables days rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. The release says demand improved in both channels. No number links the mix shift to receivables.

anomalies.name: Allowance for doubtful accounts at its thinnest in the available history
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금 비율 역대 최저
anomalies.what: The allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier, while receivables rose. The reserve ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} is the lowest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier, and fiscal 2025's {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} was the lowest of the filled years. Provisions rose in the first half, so write-offs exceeded them. The notes call credit losses de minimis but do not explain the smaller reserve, and no field carries the income effect.

anomalies.name: Recognition basis of the tariff refunds not disclosed
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 환급 인식 기준 미공시
anomalies.what: Product cost is stated net of IEEPA tariff refunds that customs is still processing. No text says whether the refunds were recognised when received or accrued as a receivable, which earlier periods they relate to, or whether more are expected. Either way, the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} carries the benefit.

anomalies.name: Warranty reserve rising, with an upward revision to prior estimates
anomalies.name_ko: 제품보증충당금 증가 및 과거 추정치 상향
anomalies.what: The warranty accrual is {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.warranty_accrual}. Fiscal 2025's ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} was the highest of the filled years, and the quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct} is above the year-ago {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio|pct}. The change in estimate for pre-existing warranties added to the liability. This departure from the past is conservative and lowers income.

anomalies.name: Unexplained measurement-period adjustment to acquisition goodwill
anomalies.name_ko: 인수 영업권 측정기간 조정 사유 미설명
anomalies.what: A measurement-period adjustment raised Duro Dyne and Supco goodwill and lowered net tangible assets acquired, changing the total investment. The numbers match the notes table, but the prose paragraph is unchanged and gives no reason. No impairment-test assumptions are in the inputs.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate rising
anomalies.name_ko: 실효세율 상승
anomalies.what: The quarter's effective tax rate rose against the year-ago quarter, and the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. The stated cause is a mix of income toward higher-tax jurisdictions. The rate moved against income, not in its favour, and no discrete benefit or valuation-allowance release appears.

anomalies.name: Amended antitrust class actions with no estimate or accrual
anomalies.name_ko: 반독점 집단소송 수정 제기, 손실 추정 및 충당금 없음
anomalies.what: After the quarter ended, the plaintiffs filed amended, consolidated class-action complaints. The company still cannot estimate a range of loss and says an adverse outcome could be material. No accrual is visible in the numbers, and the MD&A's special litigation charges line is not tied to this matter.

anomalies.name: IRS audit including cross-border transactions could exceed reserves
anomalies.name_ko: 국경 간 거래 포함 IRS 세무조사, 충당금 초과 가능성
anomalies.what: The tax note says the IRS is auditing earlier federal returns, including cross-border transactions, and that resolution could exceed reserves. The tax reserves are small, and the numbers carry no figure to test them.

anomalies.name: Hedge gains expected to lower cost of goods sold over the next twelve months
anomalies.name_ko: 향후 열두 달 헤지 이익의 매출원가 차감 예정
anomalies.what: Derivative gains held in accumulated other comprehensive loss are expected to be reclassified into earnings over the next twelve months, mainly through cost of goods sold, if prices and rates hold. This is a future support to margin that does not come from operations. No hedge figure is in the numbers.

anomalies.name: One-time tariff refunds netted inside product cost lift the quarter's margin
anomalies.name_ko: 일회성 관세 환급이 제품원가에 섞여 분기 이익률을 높임
anomalies.what: The quarter's product cost is stated net of tariff refunds that the release calls earlier than expected. The gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier, and operating income grew {ratios.growth.operating_income.year_over_year|pct}. A non-recurring credit sits inside a recurring cost line. The refund amount is not a calculator field, so no earnings adjustment could be written.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share of total assets at its highest
anomalies.name_ko: 총자산 중 비유형성 자산 비중 최고치
anomalies.what: Assets other than plant and cash are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} of total assets, the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year earlier. At fiscal 2025 year-end they were {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, against {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year before. The acquisitions made late in fiscal 2025 and higher receivables and inventory are the benign reading, which the inputs cannot split.

anomalies.name: Capital spending running above depreciation
anomalies.name_ko: 설비투자가 감가상각을 상회
anomalies.what: Trailing capital spending is {earnings_versus_cash.capital_expenditure_over_depreciation_and_amortization} times depreciation and amortization. First-half spending was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}, which MD&A ties to land and buildings for future innovation centres. This is investment, not deferred operating cost.

anomalies.name: Losses and other expenses swung from a gain to a loss
anomalies.name_ko: 기타 손익 항목이 이익에서 손실로 전환
anomalies.what: 'Losses (gains) and other expenses, net' moved from a gain in the year-ago quarter to a loss, and the MD&A table carries a special litigation charges line. The 8-K and the 10-Q agree. The amounts are small. Whether such items recur cannot be tested without a non-GAAP series, which the record lacks.

anomalies.name: Commercial paper funds the first-half receivables build
anomalies.name_ko: 상반기 매출채권 증가를 기업어음으로 조달
anomalies.what: Commercial paper outstanding is {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value} a year earlier, and total debt is {terms.debt_now} against {terms.debt_a_year_earlier}. First-half interest expense was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}. The calculator's short-term borrowing family shows {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_short_term_net} because the commercial paper tags are not read. MD&A attributes the higher interest to the commercial paper borrowings.

anomalies.name: Operating lease liabilities rising without explanation
anomalies.name_ko: 운용리스 부채 증가, 설명 없음
anomalies.what: Operating lease liabilities are {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability} a year earlier. These are fixed obligations outside reported debt. Neither reader carried text explaining the rise; leases assumed in the acquisitions are a possible benign reading.

anomalies.name: New standby letter-of-credit commitment
anomalies.name_ko: 신규 보증신용장 약정
anomalies.what: The revolving credit paragraph now records an amount committed to standby letters of credit, where the prior quarter's text recorded none. The amount is small and appears in the text only. Commercial paper of {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value} further reduces revolver availability.

anomalies.name: Change from LIFO to FIFO recasts fiscal 2025 and breaks comparability with the trend history
anomalies.name_ko: LIFO에서 FIFO로의 변경으로 과거 수치 재작성 및 비교 기준 혼재
anomalies.what: The inventory method changed from LIFO to FIFO in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025, and the release states that the fiscal 2025 comparatives are adjusted. Older trend inputs come from filings made before the change. Fiscal 2025's gross margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and inventory days of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, both the highest of the filled years, are compared against years on the old basis, and the inventory articulation gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} runs in the matching direction. The size of the change is not in the inputs.

anomalies.name: Cross-referenced note on the post-quarter acquisition absent from the notes input
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 후 인수 관련 주석이 입력 자료에 없음
anomalies.what: MD&A states the Heat Controller acquisition, completed after the quarter, and cross-references a note that is not in the notes input, which ends with the note on prior-year acquisitions. The purchase accounting, the funding and any covenant effect are therefore unseen.

anomalies.name: Only the release calls the tariff refunds earlier than expected
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 환급을 '예상보다 이르다'고 한 것은 보도자료뿐
anomalies.what: The release says earlier-than-expected tariff refunds benefited Home Comfort Solutions. The 10-Q presents the refunds only as a netting item inside product cost, with no timing qualifier. The record-high quarterly gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is consistent with a timing benefit that may not repeat.

anomalies.name: Release attributes growth to acquisitions without mentioning the organic volume decline
anomalies.name_ko: 보도자료는 매출 성장을 인수 효과로만 설명
anomalies.what: Revenue growth of {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} matches both documents. The release credits completed acquisitions, while the MD&A bridge shows acquired volume and price offsetting an organic volume decline. Trailing revenue changed by {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. The attribution is consistent but selective.

anomalies.name: Cash-flow explanations omit the larger receivables build
anomalies.name_ko: 현금흐름 설명에서 매출채권 증가 누락
anomalies.what: The release credits reduced inventory for the quarter's operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}, and MD&A credits favourable working capital for the first half. The numbers confirm the inventory point: the first-half inventory absorption was {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Neither document mentions that the first-half receivables build was larger than a year earlier.

anomalies.name: Post-quarter acquisition named differently in the release and the 10-Q
anomalies.name_ko: 분기 후 인수 건을 보도자료와 10-Q가 다르게 명명
anomalies.what: The release's CEO quote cites the acquisition of Comfort-Aire and Century brands. The 10-Q names Heat Controller and gives a price, while the release names neither. The inputs do not say whether these are the same transaction.

anomalies.name: Lower EPS guidance range presented as an update
anomalies.name_ko: 낮아진 EPS 가이던스를 '업데이트'로 표현
anomalies.what: Both ends of the full-year EPS range moved lower, while revenue and free cash flow guidance stayed unchanged. The headline uses the neutral word 'updating'. The cut comes in a quarter whose net income changed by {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} even with a one-time refund in cost, which points to weaker underlying earnings.

anomalies.name: Home Comfort Solutions profit-bridge costs grouped differently
anomalies.name_ko: 가정용 부문 이익 증감 요인의 비용 분류 차이
anomalies.what: The release states one combined figure for distribution, freight and other costs, while MD&A splits freight and distribution from miscellaneous other costs. Both are prose, and no number in the inputs tests whether the groupings tie.

anomalies.name: Inventory days high while residential volume falls, with no reserve data
anomalies.name_ko: 주거용 판매량 감소 속 높은 재고일수, 재고충당금 정보 없음
anomalies.what: Fiscal 2025 inventory days of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} were the highest of the filled years, and the first quarter of fiscal 2026 reached {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled quarters. The second quarter eased to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} a year earlier. Inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, while Home Comfort Solutions volume fell and factory under-absorption is cited. No inventory reserve or write-down is tagged, so obsolescence cannot be tested. The older years sit on the LIFO basis.

anomalies.name: Equipment share of revenue shifting
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 중 장비 비중 변화
anomalies.what: The annual product-concentration facts put equipment at {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} of revenue in fiscal 2023, {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2025. The notes report a higher equipment share for Building Climate Solutions this quarter than a year earlier. These are product facts, not customer facts, and no customer concentration is disclosed.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 직전 네 분기 합산 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로, 2025 회계연도의 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배에서 회복해 회사 자신의 과거 범위 안에 있습니다. 다만 재고 변동이 재무상태표와 현금흐름표에서 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}만큼 어긋나며, LIFO에서 FIFO로의 회계방법 변경과 인수가 원인일 수 있지만 그 금액은 공시되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기말 매출채권회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 전년 같은 분기의 {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일보다 조금 길어, 매출채권이 매출보다 약간 빨리 늘었습니다. 결제조건 연장이나 수익인식 정책 변경을 보여주는 문구는 찾지 못했습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}로 표에 있는 분기 중 가장 낮아 충당금이 얇아졌고, 관세 환급을 받은 시점에 인식했는지 미수금으로 미리 잡았는지는 공시되지 않았습니다. 반면 제품보증충당금은 {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual}로 늘었고 실효세율도 올라 이 부분은 보수적입니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 이번 분기 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}는 표에 있는 분기 중 가장 높은데, 회사가 '예상보다 이른' 일회성 관세 환급을 제품원가에서 차감했기 때문이므로 반복 가능한 수준으로 보면 안 됩니다. 비용 자본화 여부는 관련 데이터가 기록에 없어 확인할 수 없습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각, 공급망 금융, 구매약정, 보증에 관한 데이터는 기록에 없고 두 보고서에도 관련 문단이 없어 확인할 수 없었습니다. 상반기 운전자본 증가는 기업어음으로 조달되었고, 기업어음 잔액은 {terms.debt_now.parts.debt_current.lines.1.value}로 늘었습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제에 중대한 취약점이나 변경은 보고되지 않았습니다. 다만 2025년 말 재고평가방법을 LIFO에서 FIFO로 바꾸면서 과거 수치가 재작성되어 추세 비교의 기준이 섞였고, 임원·이사 변경 항목이 담긴 8-K의 본문은 확인할 수 없었습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 보도자료(8-K)와 10-Q가 함께 제시한 숫자는 모두 일치합니다. 다만 보도자료는 관세 환급을 '예상보다 이르다'고 표현하고, 매출 성장을 인수 효과로만 설명하며, 낮아진 EPS 가이던스를 '업데이트'라고 부르는 등 10-Q보다 우호적으로 표현합니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 2025 회계연도에 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 기록된 해 가운데 가장 높았고, 주거용 판매량이 줄어드는데도 재고충당금 데이터가 없어 진부화 위험을 검증할 수 없습니다. 고객 집중, 과잉 구매약정, 고객에 투자한 뒤 그 고객에게 파는 순환 거래의 증거는 찾지 못했습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
